newsitem.title: INDIA: Hockey-Goalkeepers must be adventurous,says Taylor.
newsitem.headline: Hockey-Goalkeepers must be adventurous,says Taylor.

text.p: Hockey goalkeepers need a sense of adventure in the modern-day game, Britain's Olympic gold medal winning captain Ian Taylor said on Tuesday.

"Goalkeepers the world over now look at themselves as the first line of attack and they play a crucial role in shaping moves from their own circle to the rival goal," said Taylor who is in India to conduct a a coaching clinic for goalkeepers.
Taylor, who captained Britain to Olympic gold in Seoul in 1988, said the aboilition of the offside rule had added a new dimension to the goalkeeper's craft.
"He now has to be an all-round athlete marking the lurking strikers, rushing out to tackle a raider on top of the circle and deflecting corner shots into incisive first-time passes."
But Taylor said he felt goalkeeping methods had not developed sufficiently in the past decade.
"The expectations from goalkeepers in some countries are still very low," he said. "They are just expected to block a shot at the goal. For too long the goalkeepers have been pushed into the cage."
